canonical_statement: Every finite-dimensional Hausdorff second-countable smooth manifold admits a smooth embedding into some finite-dimensional real Euclidean space.
domain_and_universes: A finite-dimensional smooth manifold M modeled on a finite-dimensional real vector space; exact Lean universes, model-with-corners data, topology instances, and countability assumptions remain to be elaborated.
quantifiers: for every Hausdorff second-countable smooth m-manifold M
there exists a finite natural number N
there exists a map e : M -> EuclideanSpace Real (Fin N)
hypotheses: M is a smooth manifold of finite dimension m
the topology on M is Hausdorff
conclusion: e is a smooth embedding: it is a topological embedding and its differential is injective at every point.
